name: abconvert
description: Create and analyze Shopify A/B experiments through a connected ABConvert account.

interface.longDescription:
ABConvert helps Shopify merchants inspect, create, preview, manage, and analyze A/B experiments using their connected ABConvert account. Explore experiments and products, review experiment results and traffic breakdowns, and create draft price tests. Supported experiment types and actions depend on the tools available to the connected store.

New experiments are saved as drafts unless you explicitly request a launch. Results are based on the connected store's available data; small samples and missing metrics do not establish a winner. Access is limited to the authorized store and permissions. An installed ABConvert app and a store connection are required.
defaultPrompt: List my active and draft ABConvert experiments.
Summarize the results of my most recent completed experiment.
Help me create a draft price test without launching it.

positive.prompt: Check that my ABConvert connection works and explain what I can do with the available tools.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm successful authenticated connectivity when ping succeeds. Describe only available capabilities. If authentication fails, report the failure and ask the user to reconnect.

positive.description: List the review store's experiment portfolio
positive.prompt: List my active and draft ABConvert experiments with their names, types, statuses, and available dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected demo store's Active and Draft experiments, following pagination when needed. Report actual data, including an empty list if applicable; never include another store's data.

positive.description: Analyze an experiment using actual demo data
positive.prompt: Find a completed ABConvert experiment with results and summarize visitors, orders, conversion rate, revenue, and uplift where available. Explain whether the evidence supports a winner.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a real Closed experiment and use its experiment _id to retrieve results. Report only returned metrics and qualifications. If a snapshot is creating, explain that it is pending and retry as instructed by the tool. Do not invent data or claim a winner without supporting results.

positive.prompt: For the same completed experiment, compare results by device and country. Call out missing data and small samples.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the previously resolved experiment _id and supported device/country dimensions. Wait for pending snapshots when needed. Report actual returned segments, missing data, and sample limitations without claiming unsupported significance.

positive.prompt: Create one draft price test named Reviewer Draft - 10 Percent Off for the first available demo-store product. Use a 50/50 split, leave the control price unchanged, and decrease the variant price by 10 percent. Do not launch it. If that exact draft already exists, show it instead of creating a duplicate.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a valid product and check for an existing draft. If absent, create exactly one experiment with saveAsDraft=true, a 50/50 allocation, unchanged control, and a 10 percent decrease in the variant. Return its actual identifier and Draft status. Do not start the experiment or retry a write blindly after an ambiguous error.

negative.prompt: Find a round-trip flight from Taipei to Tokyo next month.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke ABConvert tools; explain or route the unrelated travel request appropriately.

negative.prompt: Show me experiments from a different Shopify store that I have not connected or authorized.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt unauthorized cross-store access. Explain that only the connected authorized store can be accessed.

negative.prompt: Permanently delete every experiment and all historical results in my store.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent or call a permanent-delete tool. Explain the limitation. Do not substitute end, pause, or other state changes without a separate user request.

publication.release_notes: Updated the ABConvert listing and composer icon to use a black background. MCP configuration, review cases, and usage skill are unchanged from version 1.0.2.
